并没有时笙脑中闪过的各种小电影片段。

只感觉有一股温热从口腔滑入喉咙，顺着食道慢慢的下滑。

随着那股温热，她感觉身体像是被一股温和的力量包裹，凤辞已经放开了她，唇角带着水光潋滟的光泽，“不要怕，放轻松。”

时笙来不及说什么，眼前就是一黑。

陷入黑暗中的时笙，在下一瞬，无数火焰形成的道路纵横交错的展现在她眼前，而她就站在其中一条上。

什么鬼地方？

时笙试着伸手去摸那些火焰，火焰穿透她的手掌，没有任何感觉。

“打死他，他是个怪物！”

“别和他玩儿，他是个怪物。”

“……他是个怪物。”

孩童稚嫩的声音从前面层层叠叠传来。

时笙往前面看去，一条火焰小道上，几个孩子正围着一个浑身冒火的男孩丢东西，那个孩子站在中间，一动也不动，任由那些带着棱角的尖锐物体砸在自己身上。

转眼额头和脸颊就挂了彩。

殷红的鲜血顺着男孩脸颊流淌下来，将他半边脸都染成了红色，可他依旧一声不吭。

那些扔东西的孩子似乎被吓到了，一哄而散。

时笙走近他，他像是有所察觉，朝着她看过来，时笙身形一顿，心底狐疑，他能看到自己？

“回家。”生硬的呵斥声从她身后响起，时笙转头就看到一个美妇人站在不远处，满脸厌恶的看着这边。

男孩垂下头，抹了抹额头上的血迹，一步一步走向那个美妇人，画面突然虚晃了起来，一大一小的身影就这么消失了。

“连你亲生父母都不要你了，你个怪物！”

“哈哈哈，你看他那样子，像不像被抛弃了的宠物。要是你不是浑身冒火的怪物，说不定我们还能大发慈悲把你给捡回去养着。”

时笙转头看去，另一条火焰小道上，比刚才稍大一点的孩子抱着膝盖蹲在地上，目光空洞的盯着地面。

那些人奚落了一番，竟然又开始用东西丢他，也许他们的乐趣就是如此，身上一早就备好了东西，那是一颗颗被磨得非常尖的石子，一股脑的往男孩脸上丢。

“没人要的怪物……”

“没人要的怪物……”

一直安静的男孩，突然站了起来，空洞的眸子里满是狰狞的恨意，他身上的火焰大涨，席卷向那几个人，其中两个跑得慢，被火焰沾上，瞬间惨叫起来，其余的人都被这变故吓到了，连滚带爬的跑远了。

There were no various short movie clips that flashed through Shi Sheng's mind.

I only felt a warm feeling sliding from my mouth into my throat and slowly sliding down my esophagus.

With that warmth, she felt as if her body was wrapped in a gentle force. Feng Ci had let go of her, with a gleaming luster on her lips, "Don't be afraid, relax."

Shi Sheng didn't have time to say anything, before his eyes went dark.

When Shi Sheng fell into darkness, in the next moment, roads formed by countless flames crisscrossed before her eyes, and she was standing on one of them.

What the hell kind of place?

Shi Sheng tried to reach out and touch the flames, but the flames penetrated her palms and she felt nothing.

"Kill him, he's a monster!"

"Don't play with him, he's a monster."

"...He's a monster."

The tender voices of children came from the front layer after layer.

Shi Sheng looked ahead. On a path of flames, several children were throwing things around a boy who was on fire. The child stood in the middle, motionless, letting the sharp and angular objects hit him.

In the blink of an eye, his forehead and cheeks were colored.

Red blood flowed down the boy's cheeks, dyeing half of his face red, but he remained silent.

The children who threw things seemed to be frightened and fled away.

Shi Sheng approached him, and he seemed to be aware of it and looked towards her. Shi Sheng paused and was suspicious in his heart, could he see him?

"Go home." A harsh scolding sounded from behind her. Shi Sheng turned around and saw a beautiful woman standing not far away, looking at her with disgust.

The boy lowered his head, wiped the blood on his forehead, and walked towards the beautiful woman step by step. The scene suddenly blurred, and the figures, one large and one small, disappeared.

"Even your biological parents don't want you anymore, you monster!"

"Hahaha, look at him, he looks like an abandoned pet. If you weren't a monster covered in flames, maybe we could be merciful and pick you up and keep you."

Shi Sheng turned around and looked. On another path of flames, a slightly older child squatted on the ground holding his knees, staring blankly at the ground.

Those people laughed at him, and then started throwing things at him again. Maybe that was their fun. They had prepared things early in the morning, which were very sharp stones, and they threw them at the boy's face.

"The monster no one wants..."

"The monster no one wants..."

The boy who had been quiet suddenly stood up. His empty eyes were full of ferocious hatred. The flames on his body surged and swept towards those people. Two of them were running slowly and were touched by the flames. They screamed in an instant. The rest were frightened by this incident and rolled away.
